{{Conjecture|legends}}
Shortly after [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] rose to power, the [[Zchtek worlds]], home to the [[Jin]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was '''subjugated''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Many young Jin, including [[Dutra Zeneta]], joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in response.
